    t = np.trace(R)
    if t > 0:
        s = np.sqrt(t + 1.0) * 2
        w = 0.25 * s
        x = (R[2,1] - R[1,2]) / s
        y = (R[0,2] - R[2,0]) / s
        z = (R[1,0] - R[0,1]) / s
